originalSourcesRead.conclusion: Notes and authored internal links form the graph; visual force settings and local graph depth are presentation/navigation controls, not measured brain dynamics.

HippoRAG explicitly combines LLMs, knowledge graphs and personalized PageRank. The atlas appropriately treats brain inspiration as an analogy and avoids transferring its benchmark claims to this implementation.
Modern Hopfield/attention equivalence is a mathematical model result; it does not establish that an Obsidian vault or this local source graph reproduces biological memory.

scopeAndTermination: Authorized eligible subgraph precedes IDF/ranking; BFS uses visited IDs and finite depth/node caps; PageRank has a finite iteration cap; prerequisite ordering reports blocked descendants without calling all of them cycle members. Scores remain rankings, not truth probabilities.
publicationPrivacy: The UI reads only the generated public dataset, rejects nonpublic node/edge scopes, uses text nodes for source content, restricts external URLs, and sanitizes a small MathML vocabulary. No private company store, credentials or provider invocation is connected through this surface.
browserAcceptance: not run locally; strict real-Chromium CI gate provided
limits: This is not a complete source-by-source mathematical proof audit, production authentication audit, biological validation or target-device performance benchmark. Local cache digests are integrity checks, not hostile-host authentication.
finalUiFraming: Donna Brain · public research memory; native company memory stays private.
